content_en.prompt: Three siblings want to eat from three bowls of the same type, taken from a stack with many different types. Bowls can only be removed from the top of the stack.
content_en.question: What is the smallest number of bowls that needs to be removed to get three of the same type?
content_en.explanation: At least 13 bowls need to be removed to get three bowls of the same type (in this case, three orange bowls).
content_en.ct_explanation: A stack is a fundamental computer science data structure: only the top item can be removed at a time. To get an item buried deep in the stack, everything above it must be removed first — needing somewhere to put those items. A computer with two stacks is equivalent to a Turing machine, the most-studied theoretical model of computation — this simple structure is surprisingly powerful.

content_zh.prompt: 三個兄弟姊妹想用同一種類型的碗吃早餐。碗堆裡有很多不同類型的碗疊在一起，只能從最上面拿碗。
content_zh.question: 最少要拿掉幾個碗，才能湊到三個同款的碗？
content_zh.explanation: 至少要拿掉13個碗，才能湊到三個同款的碗（這裡是三個橘色的碗）。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 堆疊（stack）是資訊科學裡很基本的資料結構：一次只能拿最上面那個。要拿到埋在底下的東西，就必須先把上面的東西都拿掉——這就需要地方放那些暫時拿出來的東西。一台有兩個堆疊的電腦，其運算能力等同於「圖靈機」——運算理論裡研究最透徹的理論電腦模型——這麼簡單的結構，威力其實非常強大。
